label: too sparse: rare weak firing at <DEL> or early original steps of long sequences
explanation: Active on only 41 of 1M sequences (45 activations), all weak (max ~0.15). About half the mass is at the <DEL> step, mostly in L=8-9 sequences starting with 0, i or b that contain d/u early (e.g. 0 m a a 2 f v w b <DEL>). The rest is scattered: step 3 after prefixes like b d k / u d k, and a few copy steps. No coherent predicate. The best attempt (delimiter, first token in {0,i,b}, L>=6, contains d) got precision ~0.001, F1 ~0.002 on dev.
